content.name: Divya Raghavan
content.title: Senior Financial Analyst
content.summary: Financial analyst with nine years in research outsourcing, D2C consumer electronics and electric vehicles. Owns unit economics and the annual operating plan for an EV two-wheeler maker with ₹1,450 crore revenue, and her battery-cost model shaped a supplier deal worth ₹38 crore a year.

experience.title: Senior Financial Analyst
bullets: Own unit economics by scooter model and track bill-of-materials cost against plan every month.
Built a battery cell cost model that supported a dual-sourcing agreement worth ₹38 crore a year.
Coordinate the annual operating plan with eight department heads and present monthly variances to the CFO.
Guide two analysts on model structure and review their dealer-margin analysis.

experience.title: FP&A Analyst
bullets: Tracked contribution margin by marketplace channel for a D2C audio brand that grew from ₹120 crore to ₹310 crore in revenue.
Showed that returns on one marketplace were eroding margin, leading to a packaging change that halved damage claims.
Prepared monthly MIS for investors and supported due diligence for a Series C round.
Built cash-flow forecasts during the 2020 lockdowns that the founders used to renegotiate vendor terms.

experience.title: Analyst, Equity Research Support
bullets: Maintained earnings models for 15 US-listed industrial companies for an overseas research client.
Wrote quarterly result notes within 24 hours of each earnings release.
Trained four new joiners on modelling standards and client style guides.

education.school: Xavier Institute of Management and Entrepreneurship

achievements.title: ₹38 crore supplier deal
achievements.detail: Battery cost model at Voltaro used in dual-sourcing negotiations.
